decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the northern and southern walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am to 6pm  on Mondays to Friday and  9am to 1pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - REASON FOR APPROVAL:  
It is considered that this application for a single storey and rear extension to dwelling house, because of its siting, would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of 52 Fruen Road, and the area .The proposal would not be detrimental to the and appearance of the original dwelling house and the character of the street scene, to the amenities of the adjacent neighbouring properties or character of the area. On balance the development is in accordance with the Adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV.1.1 (All New Development) and H.3.4 (Alterations and Extensions): Policies ENVB.1.1 (NEW development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted (December 2003); and is generally compliant with Council's Residential Guidelines. It is considered that where the development is not compliant there are not undue adverse effects resulting from this.
description: Erection of single storey side and rear extension to dwellinghouse.
